definition.question: What must we verify or correct, and can we finish before committing these gift kits?

questions.label: Review reference
questions.question: Which gift-kit review is this?
questions.meaning: Identify this review independently from its batch and exact configuration.

questions.label: Exact gift-kit configuration
questions.question: Which batch, printed insert, destination, checkout and intended users are included?
questions.meaning: Reports and permissions must match this exact six-field scope. Revising it requires reassessing the evidence.

questions.label: Kit quantity, cutoff and expense
questions.question: What must be ready, by when and within which expense limit?
questions.meaning: Times are minutes from one declared review origin. Quotes cover the complete kit quantity; amounts are USD cents. Quantity does not silently scale quoted work.

questions.label: Actual rehearsal and check reports
questions.question: What did each scoped check report, and where is the original record?
questions.meaning: Retain exact configuration, observation time, recorder and original source text. The initial broad rehearsal failure does not mean a printed code was unreadable: record only the stated diagnostic result. This profile assumes accurate current scoped reports. Planned or simulated checks are not observations.

value.originalText: The printed insert cannot be decoded on the declared test phone.
The source artwork names the wrong destination.
The intended account completed the checkout check.

questions.label: Complete correction quotes
questions.question: What does each complete correction package cost, and how long will it take?
questions.meaning: Supply every published package quote for this batch. Frozen package effects and task dependencies cannot be edited through quotes.

questions.label: Fresh rehearsal duration
questions.question: How long will the scoped rehearsal after correction require?
questions.meaning: Reserve the complete fresh rehearsal duration, subject to the published minimum. Scheduling it does not establish a passing result.

questions.label: Handoff duration
questions.question: How much time remains for the final handoff?
questions.meaning: Reserve the complete final handoff duration after correction and rehearsal. A calculated finish does not record actual handoff.

questions.label: Person responsible for the work
questions.question: Who will perform correction, rehearsal and handoff?
questions.meaning: The same recorded person performs the three sequential activities in this bounded profile. Declared responsibility is not authenticated identity.

questions.label: Responsible people
questions.question: Which named people hold the recorded responsibilities?
questions.meaning: A person must be recorded before assignment. Permission is supplied and checked separately.

questions.label: Production capacity and availability
questions.question: When can the production resource support the complete work?
questions.meaning: Available intervals and capacity constrain correction, rehearsal and handoff. This profile has no other booked work or concurrent campaigns.

questions.label: Recorded arrangement permissions
questions.question: Which complete arrangements and working intervals have recorded permission?
questions.meaning: The supplied register is stipulated complete. Each permission must match the exact configuration, person and package and cover the full work interval; an empty register supplies no permission.

questions.label: Screening and source basis
questions.question: Who owns this review and where did its records come from?
questions.meaning: Imported source receipts and provisional screening are retained for inspection, not accepted findings.

value.meaning: Fictional bounded gifting review. The fault catalog, accurate scoped reports, correction effects and complete permission register are authored premises. A feasible plan is prospective: it does not prove completed correction, a passing rehearsal, campaign effectiveness or actual release. No probability, economic learning value, or adaptive investigation policy is inferred.
value.completionMeaning: Reviewed assessments support a prospective operating decision. This review is complete only when the separate actual-event gate records the full original quantity handed over by the original cutoff, following sourced authority, correction and a passing fresh rehearsal. A revised promise is distinct from meeting the original one.

sections.title: Has the original kit commitment been completed?

value.meaning: Requires a decision on the current accepted plan, a separate sourced spending authorization, actual correction for the selected package and current input scope, a passing fresh rehearsal on the corrected output scope, and the full quantity handed over before the original cutoff. Records are supplied assertions; this tool does not authenticate external sources.

brief.qualification: Calculated findings answer the declared operational question under the supplied inputs and rules. They do not establish external facts, issue operating permission, reserve resources, or establish actual completion.
